A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bag model is a useful tool for studying the nucleon, but that its success depends critically on a proper treatment of the zero-point motion.
the Roper resonance is an excitation of the zero-point motion in the surface of the bag, and the pion coupling is mediated by a virtual ρ.
the bag model is an effective model for the low-energy dynamics of the nucleon, but that the zero-point surface motion must be included to obtain a realistic description.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the nucleon bag is a dynamical system with a large zero-point energy, and that this zero-point energy should be treated on the same footing as the zero-point motion in the nucleon’s internal degrees of freedom.
